The '''Dozoisia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sevetta sector/Legends|Sevetta sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of [[Dozoisian Snark Venom]].<ref name="Pursuit">''[[Boba Fett: Pursuit]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Dozoisian Snark Venom]]|system=Dozoisia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Dozoisia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square S-15.<ref name="TEA" />
